rules.template: The API gateway received {attr:http.method|http.request.method} {attr:http.route} and answered {attr:http.status_code|http.response.status_code} after {duration}.
The API gateway handled the request in {duration}.
The gateway matched the request to a route in {duration}.
The gateway resolved a hostname in {duration}.
The gateway forwarded the request to the upstream service, which took {duration} to respond.
The gateway made its own {attr:http.method} call to an external service, usually Clerk's signing keys when its cache is cold, taking {duration}.
The gateway verified the Clerk session token in {duration}.
The gateway checked the per-IP rate limit in {duration}.
The gateway checked the rate limit of the user's plan in {duration}.
The gateway tagged the request with this demo session and switched tracing on for it.
The gateway checked whether a developer sandbox should receive this request.
The gateway sent the read to read-service, ready to fall back to write-service if the projection lags, taking {duration}.
The gateway attached the user's latest write version so the read reflects their own writes.
The gateway attached trace context so every downstream service joins this trace.
The gateway applied the CORS policy.
The gateway assigned a correlation id to the request.
The gateway signed the write version returned by write-service and queued it in Redis for read-your-writes.
The gateway ran its {nameRemainder} plugin in {duration}.
The gateway's {nameRemainder} plugin processed the response headers.
The gateway ran its {nameRemainder} step in {duration}.
{service} sent the response headers with status {attr:http.status_code|http.response.status_code}.
{service} sent the response body.
{service} read from the client connection for {duration}.
{service} received a {attr:http.method|http.request.method} request and answered {attr:http.status_code|http.response.status_code} after {duration}.
{service} ran its {attr:http.method|http.request.method} {attr:http.route} handler in {duration}.
{service} opened a nested transaction on Postgres database {attr:db.name|db.namespace}.
{service} committed a nested transaction on Postgres database {attr:db.name|db.namespace}.
{service} opened a connection to Postgres database {attr:db.name|db.namespace}.
{service} read from Postgres database {attr:db.name|db.namespace} in {duration}.
{service} inserted rows into Postgres database {attr:db.name|db.namespace} in {duration}.
{service} updated rows in Postgres database {attr:db.name|db.namespace} in {duration}.
{service} deleted rows from Postgres database {attr:db.name|db.namespace} in {duration}.
{service} ran {name} on Postgres database {attr:db.name|db.namespace} in {duration}.
{service} stored a key in Redis in {duration}.
{service} read a key from Redis in {duration}.
{service} bumped a cache version counter in Redis, which invalidates cached responses.
{service} deleted a cached entry from Redis.
{service} ran an atomic Lua script in Redis in {duration}.
{service} ran Redis {name} in {duration}.
{service} indexed a document into Elasticsearch in {duration}.
{service} updated a document in Elasticsearch in {duration}.
{service} searched Elasticsearch in {duration}.
{service} sent {name} to Elasticsearch in {duration}.
{service} appended to the tamper-evident ImmuDB ledger {attr:db.name} in {duration}.
{service} read a ledger row from ImmuDB together with its cryptographic proof in {duration}.
{service} queried the ImmuDB ledger {attr:db.name} in {duration}.
{service} called ImmuDB {name} in {duration}.
push-service received an event from {attr:messaging.destination.name|messaging.destination} and pushed it to the user's open browser tabs.
webhook-service checked an event from {attr:messaging.destination.name|messaging.destination} against the user's webhooks in {duration}.
The Flink antifraud job scored an event from {attr:messaging.destination.name|messaging.destination} in {duration}.
{service} consumed an event from {attr:messaging.destination.name|messaging.destination}.
{service} published an event to {attr:messaging.destination.name|messaging.destination}.
{service} handled a request in {duration}.
{service} called {name} in {duration}.
{service} ran {name} in {duration}.
